name: Card
summary: A bounded group of content about one thing: a picture, a title, one or two lines on what it's about, a line of facts and the card's own actions. The whole card can be one link. For a row of facts in a table use DataTable; for a number with its change use Statistic.
a11y: An `article` named by its heading. With `href` the title is the link and a layer of it covers the card, so a press anywhere opens it, while the keyboard and screen readers meet one link with the title as its name (not the whole card read out). Actions sit above that layer and are their own stops. The focus ring is drawn around the whole card. The picture keeps its own alternative text. A loading card is `aria-busy` and hides its shimmer from screen readers.

keys.action: the card's link, then each action

props.name: title
props.description: What the card is about: its heading, and the link's name when the card has `href`.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the whole card one link to this address (one stop for the keyboard, one big target), named by the title.

props.name: media
props.description: A picture (an `img` or an Image) shown in the card's frame. Its alternative text is its own; a picture that only decorates has `alt=""`.

props.name: ratio
props.description: The frame's shape: `ultrawide` 21:9, `wide` 16:9, `photo` 3:2 (default), `classic` 4:3, `square` 1:1. The picture fills it; give an Image a `focal` point to choose what stays in view.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: One or two words above the title: the section or kind it belongs to.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences on what it's about.

props.name: meta
props.description: A line under the description: when, how long, by whom.

props.name: children
props.description: More content under the description, such as chips or a progress bar.

props.name: tags
props.description: LR68 (opt-in): the card's tags (small Badges: Draft, Private, the section it lives in), a wrapping row close under its description, part of its words rather than content set apart.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons for the card's own actions, at its end. They stay separate stops from the card's link.

props.name: layout
props.description: `stacked`: the picture above the words (default). `beside`: the picture beside the words, stacked when the card is narrow (a lead item). `row`: the words first and a small square picture at the end (a line of a list).

props.name: variant
props.description: `outlined`: a bounded surface with a hairline (default; a grid of cards on a page). `plain`: no enclosure, only the content (an index where space already groups each card). `ruled` (LR137): no enclosure, a rule above and its words a step below it (a line of a list of entries, laid out one under another with no gap); its rule, padding, title type and description colour are theme settings (`--c-card-ruled-*`).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading's level in the page's outline.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the card's shape in shimmer while its content loads; nothing in it can be used.

props.name: size
props.description: `normal` (default). `s`: a tile in a dense grid of many (an editor's albums): the title in the label type, the description a caption, the words close together, and the actions their own row at the card's end.

settings.description: A ruled card's rule above it (Card variant ruled, LR137; default border.hairline).
A ruled card's rule colour (LR137; default color.border). A template whose lists rule in a stronger line sets it.
Between a ruled card's rule and its words, and under its words (LR137; default space.stack-item). A template sets its list rows' padding.
Between a ruled card's title, description and meta (LR137; default space.stack-pair).
A ruled card's title weight (LR137; default type.heading-4.weight).
A ruled card's title size (LR137; default type.heading-4.size). A template sets its row title size.
A ruled card's title line height (LR137; default type.heading-4.leading).
A ruled card's description colour (LR137; default color.text-muted). A template whose rows read as plain words sets its text colour.
